note: Bristol Bay Borough publishes its zoning (Title 20) only as JPEG zoning maps #1-3 on its planning page; no zoning district polygon layer is queryable. Its official parcel service (services8.arcgis.com/MqzStQjDmKoNl0E6 Parcels_view_public/FeatureServer/0) has tax parcel attributes only, with no zoning field. The borough has no incorporated cities, so no city zoning layer exists.
